senses.gloss: (followed by Dagesh forte), <he>מֵ־</he>, <cite ref="M01072"><he>מֵי־</he></cite> (before gutturals) prefix for <cite ref="M01692"><he>מִן</he></cite>,
from, of, e. g. מִמָּקוֹם from a place; מֵאֵמָתַי from what time &c.—מֵאֵל־, v. אֶל.
(v. מִדּ־) from the time that, when; from the fact that, since; also separated מִי, e. g.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:7">Sot. IX, 7</cite> <he>משנתערפה העגלה</he> after the heifer has been killed; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 2:18">Num. R. s. 2</cite> <he>מִי שהוא אומר</he> (= <cite ref="M02794"><he>מִשֶּׁ־</he></cite>) after having said; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:4:7">Y. Shek. V, end, 49ᵇ</cite> <he>מיחזר</he> when I come back; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:8:5">Y. Peah VIII, 21ᵇ</cite> top <he>מי חזרון מי חזרון וכ׳</he> when we come back,—when they came back &c.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:8:10">Y. Ber. II, 5ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>מִסַּבְרִית</he> ed. Lehm. (ed. <he>מי סברית</he>) because I thought; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:15">Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵃ</cite> <he>מנפקין</he> (<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2:4">Lam. R. to II, 2</cite> <he>מן דנפקין</he>) when they came forth; a. fr.
